UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET e = LEAST('x', $1)
@@ S-e0-fnstored
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET e = LEAST(lower(r.e), $1)
@@ S-e0-caststored
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET e = LEAST(r.e::text, $1)
@@ S-e0-subtarget
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET e = LEAST((SELECT x.e FROM aveloxis_data.repos x LIMIT 1), $1)
@@ S-k0-othercolq
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN $1 ELSE r.pn2 END
@@ S-k0-const
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN $1 ELSE 'x' END
@@ S-k0-fnstored
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN $1 ELSE lower(r.k) END
@@ S-k0-caststored
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN $1 ELSE r.k::text END
@@ S-k0-subtarget
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN $1 ELSE (SELECT x.k FROM aveloxis_data.repos x LIMIT 1) END
@@ S-k1-othercolq
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN COALESCE($1, NOW()) ELSE r.pn2 END
@@ S-k1-const
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN COALESCE($1, NOW()) ELSE 'x' END
@@ S-k1-fnstored
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN COALESCE($1, NOW()) ELSE lower(r.k) END
@@ S-k1-caststored
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN COALESCE($1, NOW()) ELSE r.k::text END
@@ S-k1-subtarget
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN COALESCE($1, NOW()) ELSE (SELECT x.k FROM aveloxis_data.repos x LIMIT 1) END
@@ O-fe-swap
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = COALESCE($1, r.fe)
@@ O-fe-3
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = COALESCE(r.fe, $1, $2)
@@ O-pnn-swap
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET pnn = COALESCE(r.pnn, $1)
@@ O-pnn-3
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET pnn = COALESCE($1, $2, r.pnn)
@@ O-pn-swap
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET pn = COALESCE(NULLIF(r.pn, ''), $1)
@@ O-g-3
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET g = GREATEST(r.g, $1, $2)
@@ O-g-least
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET g = LEAST(r.g, $1)
@@ O-e-3
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET e = LEAST(r.e, $1, $2)
@@ O-e-greatest
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET e = GREATEST(r.e, $1)
@@ O-e-coalesce
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET e = LEAST(r.e, COALESCE($1, NOW()))
@@ O-k-noelse
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN $1 END
@@ O-k-clock
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE r.k END
@@ O-k-nowarg
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc' ELSE r.k END
@@ O-k-bare-now
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = NOW()
@@ O-k-bare-ph
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = $1
@@ O-k-cond-sub
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN (SELECT x.k FROM aveloxis_data.repos x LIMIT 1) IS NULL THEN $1 ELSE r.k END
@@ O-k-pgcat-now
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN pg_catalog.now() ELSE r.k END
@@ O-k-curts-prec
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0) ELSE r.k END
@@ O-k-localts
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN LOCALTIMESTAMP ELSE r.k END
@@ O-k-curdate
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN CURRENT_DATE ELSE r.k END
@@ IO-update
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET io = $1
@@ IO-self
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET io = r.io
@@ IO-conflict
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, io) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET io = EXCLUDED.io
@@ IO-conflict-other
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, io) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = COALESCE(repos.fe, EXCLUDED.io)
@@ IO-insert
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, io) VALUES ($1,$2)
@@ IO-merge
MERGE INTO aveloxis_data.repos t USING unnest($1::int[]) s(id) ON s.id = t.repo_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET io = $2
@@ IO-delete
DELETE FROM aveloxis_data.repos WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ IO-copy
COPY aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, io) FROM STDIN
@@ G00 WHERE fe IS NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL
@@ G01 WHERE r.fe IS NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE r.fe IS NULL
@@ G02 WHERE repo_id = $2 AND fe IS NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE repo_id = $2 AND fe IS NULL
@@ G03 WHERE fe IS NULL OR repo_id = $2
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL OR repo_id = $2
@@ G04 WHERE (fe IS NULL OR fe = '')
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE (fe IS NULL OR fe = '')
@@ G05 WHERE (fe IS NULL OR fe = '' OR repo_id = 3)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE (fe IS NULL OR fe = '' OR repo_id = 3)
@@ G06 WHERE NOT (fe IS NOT NULL)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE NOT (fe IS NOT NULL)
@@ G07 WHERE fe IS NOT NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NOT NULL
@@ G08 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 WHERE fe IS NULL)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 WHERE fe IS NULL)
@@ G09 WHERE CASE WHEN fe IS NULL THEN true ELSE true END
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE CASE WHEN fe IS NULL THEN true ELSE true END
@@ G10 WHERE (fe IS NULL) IS TRUE
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE (fe IS NULL) IS TRUE
@@ G11 WHERE fe IS NULL AND true
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL AND true
@@ G12 WHERE fe IS NULL IS NOT FALSE
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL IS NOT FALSE
@@ G13 WHERE COALESCE(fe, '') = ''
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE COALESCE(fe, '') = ''
@@ G14 WHERE COALESCE(fe, 'x') = ''
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE COALESCE(fe, 'x') = ''
@@ G15 WHERE COALESCE(fe, '') = 'x'
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE COALESCE(fe, '') = 'x'
@@ G16 WHERE NULLIF(fe, '') IS NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE NULLIF(fe, '') IS NULL
@@ G17 WHERE NULLIF(fe, 'x') IS NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE NULLIF(fe, 'x') IS NULL
@@ G18 WHERE fe = ''
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE fe = ''
@@ G19 WHERE '' = COALESCE(fe, '')
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE '' = COALESCE(fe, '')
@@ G20 WHERE fe IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL
@@ G21 WHERE fe ISNULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE fe ISNULL
@@ G22 WHERE (r.fe, 1) IS NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE (r.fe, 1) IS NULL
@@ G23 WHERE ROW(fe) IS NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE ROW(fe) IS NULL
@@ G24 WHERE repos.fe IS NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE repos.fe IS NULL
@@ G25 WHERE aveloxis_data.repos.fe IS NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE aveloxis_data.repos.fe IS NULL
@@ G26 WHERE fe IS NULL AND (repo_id = 1 OR fe IS NOT NULL)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL AND (repo_id = 1 OR fe IS NOT NULL)
@@ G27 WHERE (fe IS NULL OR fe = ' ')
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE (fe IS NULL OR fe = ' ')
@@ G28 WHERE (fe IS NULL OR r.pn = '')
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE (fe IS NULL OR r.pn = '')
@@ G29 WHERE COALESCE(fe, '') = '' OR TRUE
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE COALESCE(fe, '') = '' OR TRUE
@@ G30 WHERE (fe IS NULL) = false
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE (fe IS NULL) = false
@@ G31 WHERE fe IS NULL = (repo_id > 0)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL = (repo_id > 0)
@@ G32 WHERE fe::text IS NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE fe::text IS NULL
@@ G33 WHERE COALESCE(fe::text, '') = ''
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE COALESCE(fe::text, '') = ''
@@ GF1 guard in FROM join ON
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = v.a FROM unnest($1::int[], $2::text[]) v(id, a) JOIN aveloxis_data.other o ON o.id = v.id AND r.fe IS NULL WHERE v.id = r.repo_id
@@ GF2 guard other alias same col
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = v.fe FROM unnest($1::int[], $2::text[]) v(id, fe) WHERE v.id = r.repo_id AND v.fe IS NULL
@@ GF3 guard bare with FROM item having fe (PG ambiguous)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = v.fe FROM unnest($1::int[], $2::text[]) v(id, fe) WHERE v.id = r.repo_id AND fe IS NULL
@@ GF4 guard CTE
WITH e AS (SELECT repo_id FROM aveloxis_data.repos WHERE fe IS NULL) UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 FROM e WHERE e.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ GC1 conflict where
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = EXCLUDED.fe WHERE repos.fe IS NULL
@@ GC2 conflict where on excluded
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = EXCLUDED.fe WHERE EXCLUDED.fe IS NULL
@@ GC3 conflict arbiter where (index predicate) not the update where
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) WHERE fe IS NULL DO UPDATE SET fe = EXCLUDED.fe
@@ GC4 conflict bare fe (ambiguous in PG? no: bare = target)
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = EXCLUDED.fe WHERE fe IS NULL
@@ GC5 conflict excluded source stored
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) SELECT $1, x.fe FROM aveloxis_data.repos x WHERE x.repo_id = $2 ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = COALESCE(repos.fe, EXCLUDED.fe)
@@ GM1 merge guard in WHEN
MERGE INTO aveloxis_data.repos t USING unnest($1::int[], $2::text[]) s(id, a) ON s.id = t.repo_id WHEN MATCHED AND t.fe IS NULL THEN UPDATE SET fe = s.a
@@ GM2 merge guard in ON
MERGE INTO aveloxis_data.repos t USING unnest($1::int[], $2::text[]) s(id, a) ON s.id = t.repo_id AND t.fe IS NULL WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET fe = s.a
@@ CASEfill-1 wrong guard
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = CASE WHEN r.pn IS NULL THEN $1 ELSE r.fe END
@@ CASEfill-2 extra when
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN $1 WHEN true THEN $2 ELSE r.fe END
@@ CASEfill-3 inverted
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NOT NULL THEN $1 ELSE r.fe END
@@ CASEfill-4 inverted results
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = CASE WHEN r.fe IS NULL THEN r.fe ELSE $1 END
@@ CASEfill-5 length guard
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = CASE WHEN length(r.fe) = 0 THEN $1 ELSE r.fe END
